name: OECD AI Observatory
description: An initiative within the OECD intergovernmental organization that provides a global policy observatory for AI. Publishes research and monitors AI adoption. OECD secretariat leads; scope is global; outputs are non-binding.

name: Frontier Model Forum
description: An industry-led consortium founded by major AI labs. Coordinates industry dialogue on frontier AI safety. Global scope; voluntary soft-law outputs.
